$comment: Token costs are what `claude plugin details` reported on 2026-10-03 (always-on tokens added to every session). 'global' plugins are on everywhere; 'project' plugins are installed but off, and a project turns one on in its .claude/settings.json (the toolbox and onboard-project skills do this with `claude plugin install <id> --scope project`). Anything else in the marketplaces is pulled in per project the same way. 'retired' plugins are turned off by the installer on machines that had them.
